chest-fly.criteria: Flat bench dumbbell fly with palms facing, fixed slight elbow bend. Open arms to chest level and return in an arc above chest. Head/back supported and feet fixed.

incline-curl.criteria: 45-degree incline bench, back supported, supinated dumbbells. Upper arms hang behind torso without swinging; curl and slowly lower with fixed elbows and feet.

skull-crusher.criteria: Flat bench, two dumbbells in neutral grip. Keep upper arms stable, lower weights alongside head by bending elbows, extend and return under control. Head/back supported.

limits: Reuses established procedural human/bench rigs, newly renders each app ID with revised cycle and camera; incline curl changes hammer grip to supination. Simplified anatomy/clothes/equipment, not biomechanics certification. Physical device and production pending.
